SS 304 ERW Pipes & Tubes / Welded Pipes & Tubes

We at Bhumi Steel are one of the well known Manufacturer, Exporter, Stockist, Stock Holder and Supplier of a qualitative range of Stainless Steel 304 ERW / Welded Pipes & Tubes that are being designed as per the national and international standard quality of raw materials. The most widely used of the heat resisting, SS 304 Welded / ERW Tubes & Pipes offers highest decomposition discrepancy to a great deal of chemical corrodents and industrial environment. In the meantime, our Stainless Steel ERW / Welded 304 Pipes have an amazingly enhanced formability and can be welded in the course of superior grace by all standard means.

We offer SS 304 Welded / ERW Pipes & Tubes in different sizes, thickness and standards as per made to order needs given by our customers. Stainless Steel ERW Pipes & Tubes of premium quality is supplied by Bhumi Steel, per ASTM A213, ASTM A269, ASTM A312, ASTM A778 and ASTM A511. Not only we stock standard sizes and grades of Welded tubes in Stainless Steel SS304 & SS316, but we also do maintain huge inventories of Alloy Steel based pipes in  304H, 309/S, 310/S, 317/L, 321H, 347H, Alloy 20, Duplex 2205, Duplex 2507, Alloy 200/201, C276, Alloy 400, Alloy 600, Alloy 625, Alloy 800H, Alloy 800HT, 254SMO, AL6XN and others. Stainless Steel ASTM A312 EFW Pipe, the pipe shall be suitable for bending, flanging, and similar forming operations, and for fusion welding.

Bhumi Steel has pride in providing a whole range of high-class, customizable and innovative ASTM A312 304 / 304L / 304H Stainless Steel ERW Pipes using state-of-art technology. Our range includes ASTM A312 304/304L/304H Stainless Steel ERW Pipes, Stainless Steel Seamless pipes & Tubes, Carbon Steel Seamless Pipes & Tubes and Alloy Steel Seamless Pipes & Tubes. For more than five decades, Bhumi Steel has been serving the needs of the oil and gas industries, automotive, shipbuilding, power plants. All the supply records for most of the severe environment of ASTM A312 304/304L/304H Stainless Steel EFW Pipes & Pipe line indicate that Bhumi Steel is the leader in line pipe technologies.

We have been supplying high quality ASTM A312 304 / 304L / 304H Stainless Steel ERW / Welded Tubes & Pipes with most advance technology and with most reliable quality. We place importance not just on managing material sales, but also on ‘before’ and ‘after service’.

Bhumi Steel is one of the main Stockiest, Manufacturer, Exporter, Stockist, Stock Holder and Supplier of High Quality ASTM TP Stainless Steel Welded / ERW Pipes and Tubes. We give an extensive variety of SS Pipes and Tubes in Seamless, Welded, SAW, LSAW, DSAW and so forth. Our reach involves SS 304 ERW Pipe and Tubes. Accessible in diverse measurements and levels, these stainless steel consistent tubes and pipes are broadly utilized as a part of distinctive commercial enterprises like force, building, development and some more. We additionally offer focused scope of SS pipes and tubes in customers prerequisite.

Overall interest for stainless steel is expanding at a rate of around 10% for each annum. Yearly utilization is currently well more than 20 million tones and is raising in territories, for example, the development business and family unit machines. New uses are as a rule consistently found for the alluring appearance, erosion resistance, low support and quality of stainless steel. Stainless steel is more costly than standard grades of steel yet it has more prominent imperviousness to consumption, needs low upkeep and has no requirement for painting or other defensive coatings. These components mean stainless steel can be all the more monetarily feasible once benefit life and life-cycle expenses are considered.

As an acclaimed enterprise of the industry, Bhumi Steel is involved in offering a vast array of Stainless Steel 304 ERW Pipes & Tubes / Welded Pipes & Tubes as a Manufacturer, Exporter, Stockiest and Supplier to our domestic and global clients. We supply Stainless Steel | SS 304 ERW Pipe Electric Resistance Welding Pipes in various diameters and lengths for meeting the requirement of diverse industrial segments. The durability and strength of our SS 304 ERW Pipes makes them foremost choice of customers based across the globe.
